STAGE 1 - scope and what I could read.
Goal: verifier 1 (distributed execution + shared state) for BRad-RQ r12.
Read: manifests/BRad-RQ_r12.txt (20 files listed: model/__init__.py, model/behaviour_radius.py, model/frechet_poincare.py, model/layers.py, model/model.py, model/utils.py, tests/*, train_rqvae.py), SCOPE_CONTRACT.md, findings/BRad-RQ_r12.json, and the full text of train_rqvae.py (640 lines), model/model.py (118 lines), tests/test_ddp.py (108 lines).
Scope limit observed: read of model/layers.py, model/__init__.py, model/behaviour_radius.py, model/frechet_poincare.py, model/utils.py, tests/* (other than test_ddp.py) was REFUSED with "Permission denied: read". I therefore did not read them and do NOT report them missing or defective; my judgement of layers-internal collectives is inferential and stated as such.
Prior findings: r12 list has two blocking items (model/model.py and model/__init__.py absent; get_indices/radius export). model/model.py and model/__init__.py NOW EXIST (manifest lines 5 and 9, and I read model/model.py). The radius pathway is therefore present. The second item's demanded correction (persist the radius table, raise instead of silently falling back) is only partially applied - see stage 3.
Open: audit the trainer's collective sequence and the shared-state lifecycle.
